_readme: Assumptions behind the preliminary score: the assumed winning bid by sale type, data confidence, penalties. Underwriting (rehab, hard money, MAOs, flip/BRRRR scores and weights) is in reference/deal_model.json.

win_pct_by_type._note: Typical (median) winning bid by sale type, as a share of Zillow value: outside-buyer wins in 2026 sales (n: mortgage 77, tax lien 54, free & clear 41, HOA 6). Tax-lien decrees sell at the opening (upset) price, so 0. HOA has few sales; 0.55 is a rounded median.
